title: Product Overview
description: A product page for a notebook: a gallery that becomes a swipeable rail on phones, a rating summary, colour swatches that recolour the gallery, ruling chips, a paper select, quantity and Add to bag, and the product details in an accordion.
summary: Gallery, options and Add to bag for a single product.
notes: No JavaScript. The checked colour swatch recolours the gallery and the name beside the Cover legend through :has(); browsers without :has() keep the default colour in the drawings, and the radios still work.
The views are inline SVG drawings standing in for your product photos. Replace each that has its own alt text; the colour rules then go, and switching photos per colour is your application's job.

Below 52rem the views are a .scroll-snap rail whose next view peeks in; Chromium adds one pagination dot per view (CSS scroll markers), other browsers keep the scrollbar. From 52rem they form a 2 × 2 grid beside a sticky information column.

Nothing is added to a bag: the form submits cover, ruling, paper and quantity to #bag. The price does not follow the paper choice, and stock (the sold-out ruling, the unavailable paper) comes from your catalogue.
The rating is a read-only display (.rating[role=img]) with a link to the reviews, which this block does not include.
